name: THYROGLOBULIN
description: Thyroglobulin measures thyroid protein levels and monitors differentiated thyroid cancer recurrence. This test evaluates thyroid tissue presence and response to thyroidectomy/RAI therapy.

testdetails.instrumentation: Abbott Architect, Roche Elecsys, Beckman Coulter

literatureReview: Thyroglobulin (Tg) is a thyroid-specific protein produced by thyroid follicular cells. Normal range 1.6-55 ng/mL. Undetectable after total thyroidectomy indicates complete resection. Rising levels suggest thyroid cancer recurrence. Chemiluminescent immunoassay provides high sensitivity. Anti-Tg antibodies can interfere with measurement. Used in monitoring differentiated thyroid cancer (papillary/follicular) after surgery and radioactive iodine therapy. Stimulated Tg (after TSH administration) is more sensitive than basal Tg. Critical tumor marker for thyroid cancer surveillance. Results guide further imaging and treatment decisions.
